note: Round 5: six real clips across five stages (claim, archive, weighing [two sub-clips crossfaded together], write, publish), replacing round 3's four-clip 'noise to clarity' set and its chemical-mixing ending. The closing beat is now the findings being written up and the paper going public; horizon carries no footage of its own any more, it is purely the settled last frame (deep navy, from the tail fade) while the verdict, what is still open and the input again reveal on continuous horizon-stage progress, same mechanism as before. No grade is applied to any clip this round: full brightness, natural colour, no scrim, per the standing no-darkening rule (see DECISIONS.md). `stage:"transition"` beats are the four crossfades themselves: no text, ever. Card arrival, grading, sorting and the evidence bar are driven by continuous progress through the whole `weighing` stage and held through `write`, `publish` and `horizon`, not by any one beat's local p.
